review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior IT Systems & Network Administrator to join our Cairo Headquarters. This role requires a proactive, independent professional with strong technical expertise and the ability to establish a reliable, secure and scalable IT environment. REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Minimum 3 - 5 years of proven experience in IT systems and network administration. Hands-on experience with cybersecurity, endpoint protection, backup and disaster recovery solutions. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Microsoft, Cisco, Fortinet or CompTIA certifications. WHAT WE OFFER A competitive and rewarding salary package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
